title: Tasks.org: free Todoist alternative
caption:
Todoist Pro costs $5/month (billed yearly, $60/year). Tasks.org organizes your to-do list for free ✅

✅ Subtasks, repeating tasks and tags
✅ Location reminders when you arrive somewhere
✅ Works offline, no account needed
✅ No ads, no tracking, free

💻 Android
ℹ️ The core app is free. Syncing with CalDAV, DAVx5 or EteSync, the desktop app and custom themes need an optional Tasks.org subscription (you choose the price, from $0.99/year). Google Tasks sync is free. Todoist price is the Pro plan, billed yearly ($7/month if billed monthly)

Comment "LIST" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
